description: Submits a finished Plot Speaks story for human review, credited to the name the writer chooses. Runs the format checks, a safety screen and a daily limit, then stores it; nothing is public until a person approves it. Returns a submission id and a one-time claim code for withdrawing or updating it. With replaces_id and claim_code, it replaces an earlier submission.

author_name.description: The name credited publicly as "Written by" (2 to 60 characters; a pen name is fine). Checked by the reviewer with the story.

claim_code.description: Only to update an earlier submission: the claim code from its receipt

contact.description: Optional: how the reviewer can reach the writer (email or handle). Seen only by the reviewer.

email_when_approved.description: True records the writer's request for one email, to the verified Google address of the account they signed in with, when a person approves the story (default false: no email). It takes effect only on the account connector with a verified address, is ignored on the open connector, and the receipt says whether it was accepted. The writer can turn it off at plotspeaks.com/account

replaces_id.description: Only to update an earlier submission: its submission id

secrets_md.description: The full text of secrets.md (kept private on the server; mysteries need one)

name: submit_story
title: Submit a story
